entries.reason: The recipe build models the docs body by hand; the capture reads the host page's body rule, under its own name.
The open composite's hand-written layout classes, which the shared placement rule now draws from Base UI's `data-side`, `data-align` and `sideOffset`, or from the modal popup's fixed place.
The modal rule: the Backdrop lays out its popup where the popup's own fixed place puts it, centred, or a length below the top and centred across, through `fixed-placement.ts`.
A class the recipe definition wrote on the composite's root, its scrim or its column, which the capture reads on the real Backdrop or draws through the placement rule.
The page's body rule and Fuse's base layer on it, as the browser applies them.
Tailwind's preflight and Fuse's base layer on `<html>`, as the browser applies them.
Fuse's base layer, which the recipe build modelled only for the border color: box sizing, zero border, margin and padding.
The browser's default style for the element, which the recipe build modelled only for `display`.
What Base UI writes on an element's `style`: the positioner's anchor width as the anchor's, and a popup's arrow placed on the anchor's centre.

match.detail: Base UI sets `data-starting-style` and `data-ending-style` only while the element enters or leaves

entries.reason: The enter and exit styles #707 gave the popup, its fade, scale and slide. Base UI sets these attributes only while the popup enters or leaves, and the capture reads it at rest.
The recipe build reads no `motion-safe:` variant, so it leaves #707's motion classes unmapped; the capture reads the winners of the media query and drops them as motion.
